content:
I’m an associate professor of Computer Science at Université Grenoble Alpes, teaching at IM2AG (UGA) and Ensimag (INP Grenoble).
I conduct my research within the GAIA team at Gipsa-lab. My research interests include statistical signal processing, Bayesian inference, probabilistic learning, multifractal analysis, and applications in medical imaging.
Since January 2025, I have been a member of the EURASIP Academy, a program that supports early-career researchers in the field of signal processing.
I received my B.Sc. and M.Sc. degrees in Mathematics from the University of Havana (Havana, Cuba) in 2016 and 2019. I obtained my Ph.D. in Signal Processing from the National Polytechnic Institute of Toulouse (Toulouse, France) in 2022. I worked there under the supervision of Jean-Yves Tourneret and Herwig Wendt. From March 2023 to August 2025, I was a postdoctoral research associate at Creatis and Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1 (Lyon, France) working with Adrian Basarab.
